# The level conversion programs, each its own small program (they share function names); shipped in tools\ next to the builder EXE.
function(add_tool name)
  add_executable(tool_${name} ${ARGN})
  set_target_properties(tool_${name} PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME ${name} RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/tools/$<CONFIG>)
  target_compile_definitions(tool_${name} PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS _CRT_NONSTDC_NO_DEPRECATE)
  target_compile_options(tool_${name} PRIVATE /W0 /utf-8)
  target_include_directories(tool_${name} PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/compat)
  set_target_properties(tool_${name} PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 17)
  target_link_options(tool_${name} PRIVATE /STACK:67108864)
endfunction()

file(GLOB TR3PCPSX_SRC tr3pcpsx/*.c)
add_tool(tr3pcpsx ${TR3PCPSX_SRC})
target_compile_definitions(tool_tr3pcpsx PRIVATE EXTERNAL_MODULES)
file(GLOB TRMOD_SRC trmod/*.c)
add_tool(trmod ${TRMOD_SRC})
file(GLOB TROI_SRC troi/*.c)
add_tool(troi ${TROI_SRC})
add_tool(trsfx trsfx/trsfx.c)
file(GLOB TR3MESH_SRC tr3mesh/*.c)
add_tool(tr3mesh ${TR3MESH_SRC})
file(GLOB TEXMOD_SRC texmod/*.c)
add_tool(texmod ${TEXMOD_SRC})
add_tool(3texex 3tex/3texex.c)
add_tool(3texrep 3tex/3texrep.c)
